description: Functional specification: preserve global API/token charts, add sortable top-five models and people tables, and an agent dropdown with API/token charts filtered by configured agent. Range and 15s refresh apply throughout; selected agent and sorts persist; loading/empty/error states. Reuse BOLayout, DesignSystem table/form controls and BOTelemetryComponents. BO calls Engine through NodeRouter dispatch contract, not generic invoke. Tests first: LiveView rendering/events/state preservation and global charts unaffected. Action reuse: reuse telemetry context and existing components; no new Action. E2E journey is deferred to zaq-uy9-e2e pending final UX approval.
